issues.summary: Interaction Design requirements conflict across current catalog formats.
issues.details: The live HTML and department worksheet support a 30-credit working set of DESN 348, 369, 378, 379, 458, and 468, while the linked PDF publishes a 35-credit set of DESN 216, 338, 348, 368, 378, 458, and 468.
issues.approvalNeeded: Confirm the governing Interaction Design requirement set and publish one approved catalog version.

issues.summary: Usual offering patterns for required ART courses are not present in Program Command.
issues.details: The Photography course requirements are preserved, but ART 201, 305/305L, 308/308L, and 404/404L cannot be assigned to generic quarters from the dated local course catalog.
issues.approvalNeeded: Add a dated, department-reviewed source for usual ART course offerings.

issues.summary: Some historical DESN sections occurred outside the current 2025-26 usual offering pattern.
issues.details: The dated department categorization is used for normal planning. Census history also records exceptions outside that pattern for DESN 301, 336, 348, 350, 355, 366, 368, 378, 384, 401, 458, 463, 468, and 480; those observations do not become recurring availability without department review.
issues.approvalNeeded: Confirm whether any historical exception is now a recurring quarter before changing the usual offering pattern.

issues.summary: A possible future Winter DESN 326 exception is not confirmed.
issues.details: DESN 326 remains Fall-only for planning: it appears in Fall 2023, Fall 2024, and Fall 2025 census history, is absent from the extracted Winter 2026 schedule, and the dated department categorization says Fall only. A possible future Winter exception must not be treated as normal availability until it appears in an approved schedule.
issues.approvalNeeded: Record an approved dated schedule that explicitly offers DESN 326 in Winter before enabling a Winter placement.
